NASA night-sky imagery

Deep Star Maps (2012), Ernie Wright.
Credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio.
Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/3895/

The built-in UV-cube and voxel skies are generated locally by this application.
User-uploaded skyboxes remain in browser memory and are never uploaded by this app.
